task: Add a bounded DONE version bump policy so CLI capability contract and proof files can trigger a patch bump.
outcome: After a story changes docs/CLI.md or packages/main/tests/** and reaches DONE, the DONE merge treats it like a watched CLI capability input: it builds packages/main, patch-bumps the CLI version, and no longer prints the old skip message; unrelated docs/requirements and experiments/** still skip.
facts: B-3a4d delivered a CLI capability proof but skipped version bump because only runtime/package inputs were watched.
The current DONE merge predicate is shouldBuildDoneMainPackageForChangedPaths in packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts.
The same predicate controls the post-DONE packages/main build and the patch version bump decision.
version-bump-smoke already exercises the predicate and skip line semantics.
constraints: Do not include all docs/** in the bump policy.
Do not include experiments/** or paper artifacts.
Do not manually edit package version files during DEV.
Keep the change patch-only and bounded to the declared paths.
unknowns: Whether future policy should split build trigger from version-bump trigger is outside this story.
